soon.intro1: Yaşam Sistemi keeps growing to bring different astrology traditions together on one platform, each with its own calculation rules.
soon.intro2: Work is under way on new astrology charts, traditional Horary schools, Vedic Prashna methods and the new possibilities offered by our calculation infrastructure.

process.p1: In this section, “In development” covers research, technical feasibility review, calculation verification, integration preparation or software development.
process.p2: Not all of the listed techniques are available yet. Some topics concern extensions of existing analyses.
process.p3: New features will be released step by step as technical verification and expert review are completed.
process.p4: No firm release date is promised.
